_comment: Committed at Phase 6.5 deployment. A18 diffs live state against this artifact on each verification cycle. This file must NOT live in the database — a compromised cluster cannot alter what is verified.

authority_matrix_summary.role_producer: INSERT on belief (pending only, via v_pending_insert), INSERT on provenance
authority_matrix_summary.role_semantics: UPDATE supersession cols on belief, INSERT on contradiction_event, SELECT on v_trusted_current
authority_matrix_summary.role_integrity: SELECT all belief statuses, INSERT on integrity_verdict + quarantine, UPDATE belief.status
authority_matrix_summary.role_consumer: SELECT on v_trusted_current ONLY — structurally cannot read pending or quarantined
authority_matrix_summary.role_auditor: SELECT on all tables including history
